records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Group!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, reached first_project on 2026-09-10 so there is some real activity, but no invite sent and no key milestone with 8 days left. Zero customer replies since the welcome note (email:b4c98a4b) and no tickets suggest low engagement momentum, so unaided activation is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right foundation.

Most teams get the most out of Wrenfield once someone else is in there with them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add a few at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whatever next step is most useful for Willow Group.

Best,
Priya
